verification.precondition: A structurally valid v2 session stores a locally frozen shared Question or ContextFrame as an immutable workspace resource.
verification.stimulus: Validate valid shared resources, a structurally malformed Question, a duplicate-option Question, and a cross-boundary ContextFrame through whole-session semantics.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Every locally bound shared resource passes both its exact frozen schema and its generated semantic validator before Survey graph resolution.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The runner reports the literal assertion: the v2 session validates every frozen shared resource before graph resolution
verification.forbiddenMutation: No generic ResourceDocument wrapper may allow a malformed or semantically invalid locally bound shared resource into a valid session.

behavior: a v2 session validates every locally bound shared resource against its frozen structural and semantic authorities
